summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive premium accumulation in SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes for 2026 and 2027. Notable directional conviction is seen in the aggressive accumulation of SPXW 6000C ($677.5M) and SPX 7000C ($408.5M) for late 2026, alongside a massive $574.5M put position in SNDK for 2027. Persistent institutional interest is highly concentrated in SPX 7000C and 8000C contracts, with multi-day positions totaling billions in premium, signaling a structural bet on significant index expansion over the next 2-3 years. Traders should monitor for any volatility spikes in SPX/SPY that could threaten these long-dated call structures, and watch for follow-through in NVDA and AMD, which both show strong intraday call buying (P/C < 0.50).
